title: Software Technical Lead
description: Software Technical Lead Job title: Software Technical Lead Location: Chennai, Tamil Nadu Work model: Primarily Office Based Reporting to: Engineering Manager Team size: Initially 4–7 software engineers, with close collaboration across QA, DevOps/platform engineering, and firmware/hardware-adjacent teams About the role ePropelled develops intelligent propulsion and power management systems for uncrewed vehicles. We are looking for a hands-on Software Technical Lead to develop cloud-based software that connects our hardware products with user applications. Your strongest experience will be in software development, backend services and full-stack delivery. You will bring strong production development skills in Python or Java, experience delivering containerised services, and practical exposure to IoT, telemetry or other connected-device systems. You will lead technical decisions, contribute code and help other engineers deliver reliable software. Working with firmware and hardware colleagues, you will develop a deeper understanding of our devices, their interfaces and the environments in which they operate. Prior experience developing embedded firmware, motor-control software or autonomous-vehicle software is not required. What you will do Lead the design and delivery of backend services, APIs, telemetry processing and supporting web applications. Remain directly involved in implementation, code review, troubleshooting and technical problem-solving for approximately 70–80% of your time. Design service boundaries, data models and interfaces, choosing an appropriate architecture for the product’s scale and complexity. Develop and deploy containerised applications using Docker and Kubernetes, working with colleagues responsible for infrastructure and operations. Build and improve automated tests, CI/CD pipelines and release processes. Use logs, metrics and traces to diagnose problems and improve service reliability. Work with firmware and hardware engineers to define device-to-platform interfaces, data formats, version compatibility and failure behaviour. Address connected-system concerns such as intermittent connectivity, retries, duplicate messages, device identity and access control. Contribute to web dashboards and operational interfaces, and guide integration between frontend and backend components. Mentor engineers, explain technical trade-offs and help translate product requirements into achievable development work. You will work with an experienced Software Engineering Manager who will handle day-to-day line management and scheduling. This is a technical leadership role, not a line-management role. Essential experience We are looking for evidence of the following capabilities: Hands-on technical leadership. You have taken responsibility for substantial software delivery, made and explained architectural decisions, reviewed code and supported other engineers. You continue to write and debug production code. Strong Python or Java development. You have built and maintained production backend services in at least one of these languages and can explain your approach to testing, performance, concurrency and maintainability. You are willing to learn other languages where the work requires them. Cloud and distributed systems. You have delivered services on a cloud platform and have practical experience with microservices, APIs and asynchronous messaging. You understand trade-offs involving consistency, failure handling, scalability and operational complexity. Containers and Kubernetes. You have practical experience packaging, deploying and troubleshooting applications using Docker and Kubernetes. CI/CD and production quality. You have worked with version control, automated builds, tests and controlled releases, and have contributed to improving these practices. Observability. You have used logs, metrics and tracing to investigate production behaviour. Experience with tools such as Prometheus, Grafana or OpenTelemetry is relevant; familiarity with every named tool is not required. Genuine connected-system exposure. You have contributed to a deployed IoT, telemetry, device-management, industrial monitoring, telematics or comparable hardware-connected system. You can explain your own contribution, how device data reached the application, and how you investigated integration or reliability problems. Full-stack delivery. You understand how modern web applications interact with backend services and have contributed to delivering user-facing functionality. Your deepest expertise may be in backend development; direct ownership of cloud infrastructure is not the primary focus of this role. Data and security fundamentals. You have practical SQL and relational database experience, together with an understanding of authentication, authorisation, secrets handling and secure service communication. Collaboration and learning. You communicate clearly, investigate unfamiliar problems systematically and work effectively with colleagues from other engineering disciplines. At least seven years of relevant software engineering experience, including technical leadership responsibilities, is required. Useful additional experience Any of the following would be valuable. You do not need experience in all of them: MQTT, device provisioning, device identity or remote software updates. Edge gateways, Linux-based devices or systems that operate with unreliable connectivity. PostgreSQL, time-series data or telemetry storage and processing. Practical development experience in both Python and Java. Proficiency in at least one is essential; experience with both is an advantage. Frontend frameworks such as React, Angular or Vue. Robotics, manufacturing, industrial automation or uncrewed vehicles. Integrating AI or machine-learning services into a production application. Technical ownership and development Your initial technical ownership will focus on software development. You will lead the development of software deployed on cloud platforms and integrated with connected devices and user applications. Firmware and hardware colleagues will contribute their specialist knowledge and collaborate on interfaces, diagnostics and system behaviour. Platform Engineering colleagues will provide infrastructure and specialist expertise in CI/CD, deployment and platform operations. You will be expected to develop a broader understanding over time, ask informed questions and recognise when specialist input is needed. This is a hands-on technical leadership role. It involves guiding software engineers in their approach to software development and taking responsibility for technical delivery. Background and qualifications A relevant degree or equivalent practical experience is welcome. We consider candidates from different industries. What matters is evidence of production software development and delivery, technical leadership and relevant connected-system experience. If you meet the essential capabilities but have not used every technology mentioned, we encourage you to apply. Please describe a system you helped deliver, your personal contribution and a difficult technical problem you resolved. If you are interested, kindly share your updated resume to hr-india@epropelled.com or anithak@epropelled.com Pay: ₹1,000,000.00 - ₹2,200,000.00 per year Benefits: Food provided Health insurance Paid time off Provident Fund Work Location: In person

Continuous Innovation Evaluate emerging technologies such as edge AI, synthetic data, reinforcement learning, and large language models for industrial and business applicability. Stay current with developments in AI, machine learning, and digital tools, and recommend practical adoption opportunities. Technical Expertise Strong programming skills in Python, C++, or similar languages, and proficiency with modern development environments such as VS Code. Hands-on experience with machine learning and deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow and/or PyTorch, as well as classical ML tooling (e.g. scikit-learn, gradient boosting methods). Experience with time-series analysis, optimization methods, and data-driven model development. Practical experience with GenAI and their surrounding stacks (RAG, vector databases, A2A) Experience handling unstructured data; technical documents, specifications, reports; alongside structured and tabular data. Solid grounding in cloud services and architecture (Azure, AWS ) Working knowledge of data engineering fundamentals: SQL, data pipelines, and structured/unstructured data handling. Familiarity with MLOps practices, model deployment, and integration into production environments is an advantage. Domain Knowledge (Secondary) Sound knowledge of artificial intelligence, combined with a strong interest in emerging technologies and digital trends. title: AI Engineer
description: About the company and the product India Health Link is building a new multi-tenant Hospital Management Information System (HMIS) — one platform serving many hospitals. Artificial Intelligence (AI) is planned for every module, but the core system must work perfectly with every AI feature switched off. That means AI ships as plug-ins behind a protocol, with measured quality — not as code sprinkled through the clinical modules. One engineer owns that entire layer. Our stack : Python for the AI services, Amazon Bedrock (Mumbai region) for large language models (LLMs), TypeScript and NestJS for the core, PostgreSQL 16, Amazon Web Services (AWS) — ECS Fargate, S3, EventBridge, OpenSearch. What you will build The plug-in runtime and registry : manifest and scopes, event subscriptions, and a per-hospital install and kill switch. The LLM gateway : model routing, prompt and version management, cost and token controls, redaction of identifiers before anything leaves the boundary, and full auditing of every request. The three launch plug-ins : 1 Discharge Summary Assistant — drafts a summary from the encounter record for the doctor to edit and sign. 2 Clinical Scribe — turns a consultation conversation into structured notes. 3 Coding Assist — suggests International Classification of Diseases (ICD) and procedure codes from the note. The evaluation harness : a golden dataset, regression runs on every prompt change, and dashboards for acceptance rate and edit distance per hospital. Responsibilities Treat every output as a suggestion. Nothing your layer produces is ever written directly into a clinical or financial record without a human accepting it. Own quality measurement. "It looked good in testing" is not a release criterion here — acceptance rate is. Work with the clinical advisors to sign off outputs before a plug-in is enabled for a hospital. Keep patient data handling defensible: what is sent, where it is processed, what is retained, and the audit record for every call. Control cost per plug-in per hospital, and report it monthly. Requirements Python, and comfort building and operating a production service — not only notebooks. Practical LLM application patterns: prompt design, structured and schema-constrained output, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), function calling, streaming, and evaluation. Has shipped at least one LLM feature to real users, and can describe how quality was measured and what was changed as a result. Amazon Bedrock, the Anthropic API or the OpenAI API in production. Pragmatism: you choose the smaller model and the simpler prompt when it does the job. Good to have Speech-to-text for Indian-accented English and code-switched speech — the Clinical Scribe depends on it. Medical coding, clinical text, or de-identification work. TypeScript, so you can meet the core team halfway on the gateway. Evaluation tooling and experiment tracking.
